questions.prompt: Present both familiar viewpoints about the social obligation, then give a supported position with an explicit limit on certainty.
questions.context:
A says mutual help is important and takes an unanswered request as unwillingness to help. B also values mutual help but says the recipient may not have understood the request. The only confirmed fact is that no reply has arrived; neither intention nor understanding is established. Present both viewpoints and a qualified position.
Familiar meanings available: to help each other; other people; somebody else; I/me in context-dependent conversational self-reference; might; possible; according to; based on.

rubric.text: I represented both viewpoints without overstating either.
